bibl.title: One more Fragment from the Land Register (P.Flor. I 64 + fr. Alex. Mus.).
bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Alex. sans No. d'Inv. + P. Flor. I, 64 + P. Mich. Inv. 6822f
Nikos Litinas, One more Fragment from the Land Register (P.Flor. I 64 + fr. Alex. Mus.).
bibl.note: Edition of a small papyrus fragment from the Michigan Papyrology Collection. It seems to be part of a land register already known from a Florentine papyrus (P.Flor. I 64). In the appendix the text of the latter papyrus is presented with some improvements.
